About me

I’m a third-year B.E. student in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at Marathwada Mitra Mandal’s Institute of Technology, Pune (SPPU, 2024 pattern). I work across AI/ML, full-stack web, cloud and IoT, and I like shipping things people can actually open and use.

Outside class I’m a Google Student Ambassador, a Techfest IIT Bombay Campus Ambassador, Secretary of the Google AI Dev Club at MMIT, and the creator of the YouTube channel Rhythm and Seconds.
